title: quamoclit coccinea var. hederifolia
intro: Quamoclit coccinea var. hederifolia, commonly known as ivy-leaved clematis or traveller's joy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Clematis genus. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to alleviate stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Quamoclit coccinea var. hederifolia include its antispasmodic and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe muscle spasms and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
